inputs.label: Serum albumin
help: For this patient population the serum albumin must be less than 3 g/dL

notes: In this calculator, mcg is the abbreviation for micrograms.

Free phenytoin concentrations are preferred in patients with renal dysfunction, hepatic dysfunction, hypoalbuminemia, and those who are critically ill. If free phenytoin concentrations are unavailable, predictive equations may be used in adult patients to estimate free phenytoin levels and help guide dosage adjustments, along with the assessment of patient response and tolerability. Overall predictive performance of the equations varies (Cheng 2016; Kiang 2016).
Equations for predicting free phenytoin (from total phenytoin) after adapting for clinical variables:
For general medicine, critical care, or neurology (all without ESRD)

Cheng revised Winter-Tozer equation (Cheng 2016): Adjusted free phenytoin = (Measured total phenytoin divided by [(0.275 x albumin) + 0.1]) x 0.1 For ESRD on hemodialysis Soriano revised Winter-Tozer equation (Soriano 2017): Adjusted free phenytoin = (Measured total phenytoin divided by [(0.2 x albumin) + 0.1]) x 0.1 For hypoalbuminemia (serum albumin <3 g/dL; hospitalized, non-critically ill patients) (Khan 2017):

Anderson revised Winter-Tozer equation (Anderson 1997): Adjusted free phenytoin = (Measured total phenytoin divided by [(0.25 x albumin) + 0.1]) x 0.1 Equations for predicting adjusted total phenytoin (from total phenytoin) after adapting for clinical variables:
For general medicine, critical care, or neurology (all without ESRD)
Cheng revised Winter-Tozer equation (Cheng 2016): Adjusted total phenytoin = (Measured total phenytoin divided by [(0.275 x albumin) + 0.1])
For ESRD on hemodialysis Soriano revised Winter-Tozer equation (Soriano 2017): Adjusted total phenytoin = (Measured total phenytoin divided by [(0.2 x albumin) + 0.1])
For hypoalbuminemia (serum albumin <3 g/dL; hospitalized, non-critically ill patients) (Khan 2017):
Anderson revised Winter-Tozer equation (Anderson 1997): Adjusted total phenytoin = (Measured total phenytoin divided by [(0.25 x albumin) + 0.1])
The calculator uses equations derived from assays performed at 25°C.
